author: fenglin
model: Controlled protocol adapters inside official rc.5 for regressions in chat, native decisions, tools, image delivery and context compaction. Independent short runs used real Qwen, neural speech and object detection.

realModelSmoke.adapter: Credential-free loopback llama.cpp with all four review choices expressed as a JSON schema. The first short draft used text generation without the native tool catalogue.

unconstrainedExperiments: The unconstrained review repeated the draft instead of returning any structured decision. Spirit withheld it.
The model selected publish on its own, but included the text field that only revise may supply. Spirit withheld it.
